title: Pure Mega Phantom Beast
summary: Mecha Phantom Beast is a WIND Machine Token-generating Xyz and Synchro archetype where every Main Deck monster increases its Level by the combined Levels of all 'Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens' (Machine/WIND/Level 3/ATK 0/DEF 0) you control and cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while you control a Token! With Mecha Phantom Beast Auroradon Forbidden on the TCG Banlist, pilot the pure strategy by summoning Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion, Tetherwolf, and Megaraptor alongside Aerial Recharge to flood the field with Level 3 Tokens—turning your Level 4 Mecha Phantom Beasts into Level 7s or Level 10s to Xyz Summon Mecha Phantom Beast Dracossack and Synchro Summon Mecha Phantom Beast Jaculuslan!

allow.Deskbot 001: Level 1 EARTH Machine Tuner that automatically revives itself from your GY whenever 2 or more Machine monsters are Special Summoned at the same time!
allow.Scrap Recycler: Level 3 EARTH Machine starter that sends Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion directly from your Deck to the GY—immediately triggering O-Lion's GY effect to summon a Level 3 Mecha Phantom Beast Token AND granting an extra Mecha Phantom Beast Normal Summon!
allow.Foolish Burial: Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion from your Deck to the GY to summon a Mecha Phantom Beast Token and grant an extra Normal Summon.
allow.Superdreadnought Rail Cannon Gustav Max: Rank 10 Machine Xyz summoned using two Level 4 Mecha Phantom Beasts whose Levels are increased to 10 by controlling two Level 3 Tokens.
allow.Number 11: Big Eye: Rank 7 Xyz summoned using two Level 4 Mecha Phantom Beasts whose Levels are increased to 7 by controlling one Level 3 Token.
allow.Phantom Fortress Enterblathnir: Rank 9 WIND Machine Xyz boss that detaches 1 material to banish 1 card from your opponent's field, hand, GY, or top of their Deck.
allow.Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon: Level 8 WIND Dragon Synchro summoned using Mecha Phantom Beast Concoruda (Level 7 Synchro) + Level 1 Deskbot 001.
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Mecha Phantom Beast from your hand.

main: Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion

Core Level 2 WIND Machine Tuner: when sent to the GY from anywhere, Special Summons 1 'Mecha Phantom Beast Token'; banishes itself from your GY to immediately Normal Summon 1 'Mecha Phantom Beast' monster from your hand!
Mecha Phantom Beast Megaraptor

Core Level 4 WIND Machine (1900 ATK): Special Summons 1 Mecha Phantom Beast Token whenever a Token is Special Summoned to your field, increases its Level by the Levels of your Tokens, cannot be destroyed while you control a Token, and searches ANY 'Mecha Phantom Beast' monster from your Deck!
Mecha Phantom Beast Tetherwolf
Core Level 4 WIND Machine (1700 ATK): Special Summons 1 Mecha Phantom Beast Token when Normal Summoned, and tributes 1 Token during battle to gain 800 ATK.
Mecha Phantom Beast Coltwing

Level 4 WIND Machine: when Special Summoned while you control another Mecha Phantom Beast monster, Special Summons 2 Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens, and tributes 2 Tokens to destroy 1 card your opponent controls and banish it!
Mecha Phantom Beast Harrliard

Level 4 WIND Machine (1800 ATK): once per turn when a monster you control is Tributed, Special Summons 1 Mecha Phantom Beast Token, and tributes 1 Token to Special Summon a Mecha Phantom Beast from your hand!
Mecha Phantom Beast Hamstrat
Level 3 WIND Machine: Special Summons 2 Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens when flipped face-up, and tributes 1 Token to revive any 'Mecha Phantom Beast' monster from your GY!
Mecha Phantom Beast Blue Impala
Level 3 WIND Machine Tuner: can Synchro Summon a Machine Synchro Monster using Mecha Phantom Beast monsters in your HAND as non-Tuner materials, and banishes itself from GY to summon a Token.
Scrap Recycler
Normal Summon starter that sends Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion from your Deck to the GY—spawning a Level 3 Token and letting you banish O-Lion to Normal Summon Megaraptor or Tetherwolf!
Deskbot 001
Level 1 Machine Tuner that revives itself from the GY every time Dracossack, Coltwing, or Megaraptor + O-Lion summons 2 Machine Tokens at once.
Scramble!! Scramble!!

Quick-Play Spell: if your opponent controls more non-Token monsters than you do, tributes any number of Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens to Special Summon an equal number of 'Mecha Phantom Beast' monsters directly from your Deck!
Aerial Recharge
Continuous Trap: Special Summons 1 Mecha Phantom Beast Token once per turn during EITHER player's turn.
Foolish Burial
Limited to 1 in TCG: sends Mecha Phantom Beast O-Lion to the GY to summon a Token and grant an extra Normal Summon.
extra: Signature Rank 7 WIND Machine Xyz boss: detaches 1 material to Special Summon 2 Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens, cannot be destroyed while you control a Token, and tributes 1 Mecha Phantom Beast to destroy any 1 card on the field!
Signature Level 9 WIND Machine Synchro boss: tributes Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens on Synchro Summon to discard an equal number of random cards from your opponent's hand.
Signature Level 7 WIND Machine Synchro: Tokens you control cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects.
Rank 9 WIND Machine Xyz boss that detaches 1 material to banish 1 card from your opponent's field, hand, GY, or top of their Deck.
Rank 10 Machine Xyz summoned using two Level 4 Mecha Phantom Beasts while you control two Level 3 Tokens.
Rank 7 Xyz summoned alongside Dracossack that steals an opponent's monster.
Level 8 WIND Synchro summoned using Level 7 Concoruda + Level 1 Deskbot 001.
Link-2 Machine that Special Summons Coltwing or Megaraptor from your hand.
